verdict.rationale: The pack has no first-party evidence of trend dashboards: no cross-project or cross-team error views, no top-regressions list, no new-issues-per-release breakdown, and no volume-over-time charts. The blog title "Deeper reporting" is too vague to credit, and GlitchTip explicitly says it avoids "dashboard building" (in its performance context). Exploring GlitchTip data in Grafana through Grafana's Sentry data source is an external-tool workaround, and release tracking via the CLI is a building block, not the dashboard capability itself.
